task: Cover the inbox page (`/`), seeded with four messages of which three are unread. The heading shows the number of unread messages in parentheses. Opening a message shows its subject, sender and body and marks that message, and only that message, as read, lowering the count. Mark all read clears the count and the unread markers. The Unread only filter hides the read messages. Read state is stored on the server, so a reload shows the same unread count and markers.
